definition: Teaching games are a game-based learning approach in physical education and sport pedagogy in which students learn by playing games rather than mainly through isolated drills. They use developmentally appropriate, often modified game situations and tactical questioning to help learners understand core tactical principles, solve gameplay problems, and improve game reading, decision making, and skill execution.
